svg.title: Decide who may create teams — SoftTrack web design mockup (#306)
svg.desc: Creating a team asks only that somebody is signed in, each team takes a key, and a key is never given back. An instance setting says who may create teams: anyone, site admins only, or named people; where it is restricted, New team leaves the sidebar, the API refuses with a code, and somebody who may not create a team can ask for one.
svg.text: · a key is never given back
